items.title: Super switching sees billions flow out of traditional funds, at a risk
items.description: There is now more than $1 trillion in self-managed superannuation funds, which means a big chunk of money isn't regulated by APRA, and it's the rate of the shift into SMSFs and less-regulated managed investment schemes that has regulators worried.

items.title: Health minister stops short of requesting coronial inquest into baby's death
items.description: WA's health minister says she would support a coronial inquest into the death of an eight-month-old girl at Kalgoorlie Health Campus, but says it is a decision for the state coroner.

items.title: Family who spent $250,000 on IVF welcomes new rebate scheme in SA
items.description: A South Australian couple who spent $250,000 on fertility treatments say the government's IVF rebate will make a "huge difference" for people trying to conceive.

items.title: Victorian MP says she misunderstood meaning of 'headlock' in assault allegation
items.description: State Liberal MP Moira Deeming says she misunderstood the meaning of the term "headlock", after alleging her party room colleague Matthew Guy assaulted her.

items.title: Allan government under pressure amid latest Big Build corruption allegations
items.description: The Victorian premier has backed her government's response to corruption in the construction industry, despite criticism from across politics and integrity experts.

items.title: Bondi terror attack survivor received 'influx of hate' hours after shooting
items.description: Deepfake and altered images depicting a Bondi Beach terror attack survivor holding an Academy Award while covered in blood spread "like wildfire" online just hours after the shooting, a royal commission has heard.

items.title: France records 1,000 excess daily deaths as record heatwave broken by severe storms
items.description: More than 150 million Europeans swelter in "extreme heat", which scientists say has been the worst the continent has ever recorded.

items.title: Live: 'It's time': Liberal frontbencher calls for party to rebrand
items.description: Liberal frontbencher Melissa McIntosh says her party needs a rebrand after support for the Coalition hit a new low in the latest opinion polls. Follow live.

items.title: Vanuatu critical infrastructure to remain 'free from militarisation' under pact
items.description: Vanuatu's Prime Minister Jotham Napat and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese ink the Nakamal Agreement, almost 10 months after Mr Napat pulled out of a planned signing ceremony in Port Vila, citing concerns around sovereignty.

items.title: 'I've got all the symptoms': Matty Robbins was a hero of the AFL. Now he's suffering
items.description: More than 30 professional and amateur Aussie Rules players have been diagnosed with CTE, revealing that the brain trauma crisis is striking all levels of the game.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
